memory.name: remember
memory.description: remember("fact") — Save a lasting fact about the user to long-term memory that persists across ALL future chats. Call this quietly when the user shares something personal worth keeping: their name, job, location, preferences ("I'm vegetarian"), ongoing projects, names of pets/family/friends, things they love or hate, or anything they'd expect you to recall days from now. fact.description: One short sentence about the user phrased as a standalone note, e.g. "user's dog is named Max" or "user prefers dark mode".

memory.name: recall
memory.description: recall("topic") — Look up summaries of past conversations that touched on a topic.
